content: Within three months, Sabrina will independently grasp and manipulate a one-inch cube using a pincer grasp in 4 out of 5 opportunities during supervised play, to enhance fine motor development and dexterity.
Within four months, Sabrina will crawl using reciprocal movements independently across a 5-foot distance in 4 out of 5 opportunities, promoting gross motor coordination and core strength.
Within five months, Sabrina will visually track a moving object across midline with minimal verbal prompts in 4 out of 5 opportunities during structured play, supporting visual-motor integration.
Within six months, Sabrina will clap hands sequentially while singing a nursery rhyme with minimal cues in 4 out of 5 sessions, enhancing bilateral coordination and midline crossing.
Within three months, Sabrina will drink from a sippy cup with handles independently in 4 out of 5 meal opportunities, to improve self-care and adaptive skills.

Within six months, Sabrina will engage in a sensory-rich activity (e.g., sand play) with minimal sensory-seeking or avoiding behaviors in 4 out of 5 sessions, improving sensory processing and regulation.
Within three months, Sabrina will use a palmar grasp to hold a crayon and make random marks on paper independently in 3 out of 5 opportunities, to begin developing pre-writing and tool use skills.
Within five months, Sabrina will initiate and participate in interactive play with a caregiver for at least 5 minutes in 4 out of 5 opportunities, fostering social participation and engagement.
